summary.text: Gillian Battino is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Cory Tomczyk.
She holds an M.D. and is the director of RAD-AID Latin America.

paragraphs.text: Gillian Battino was born in Athens, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree from John Carroll University in 1992 and an M.D. from the Ohio State University College of Medicine in 1996.
She later earned a graduate degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 2011.

Battino is the director of Rad-AID Latin America and is affiliated with the NAACP Milwaukee branch, the American College of Radiology, the Wisconsin Medical Society and the Radiological Society of North America.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 29 on August 11, 2026.
